notes:
## Changes
- **Scene tiles:** the tooltip no longer covers the screenshot. It shows when you point at the scene's name and details below it, leaving the picture and its hover preview clear.

## Fixes
- **Folder search:** searching in Folders now matches only each folder's own name, performers, studios, tags, drive and categories, not those of the scenes inside it, so finding a folder by name is easy again. To search scenes, use All scenes or the Performers, Studios and Tags windows.
linuxNotes:
First Linux preview of Video Shelf: the whole app on Ubuntu and similar systems (.deb). It uses the same catalogue as the Windows app.

Install with:

    sudo apt install ./videoshelf_0.12.0_amd64.deb
